reason: Provide donor-level rather than gene/target-level uncertainty. Fixed before any donor model test result was inspected.
outer_fold: test donor = order[i]; validation donor = order[(i+1) mod 4]; the remaining two donors train
gene_universe: all 18129 genes in published pseudobulk, no donor-pooled HVG selection
unit: delta_log2_CPM_plus_1, separately evaluated from pooled DESeq2 effects
QC: n_cells>=5, finite nonnegative counts and positive aggregate library; no keep_effective_guides, keep_for_DE or significance-based filtering
selection_and_calibration: Target-hash split within the sole validation donor; never test donor labels
budget: Same as experiment_plan_frozen.json, independently tuned per outer fold on its own validation donor
uncertainty: Paired contrast using four held-out donor scores, seeds averaged inside donor. Only four biological donors and overlapping CV training sets; not a large independent clinical validation.
upstream_limitation: Published curated target labels and primary assayed target coverage universe retained.
